description:
Get date-free property and room details, including traveler-facing amenities, property-authored direct-booking benefits, policies, Events & Weddings, room profiles, published image links and up to two bounded image previews (property and uniquely matched room). Missing previews retain links. When the traveler names a room or unit, pass that wording as roomQuery before treating it as another property.
For a focused property/room discussion, proactively use show_property_photos when published photos help. Use PROPERTY or the uniquely matched ROOM; preserve room identity. Skip missing/ambiguous photos, unsupported UI, text-only preferences and already-shown galleries. Image links are fallback references, not a replacement for the supported viewer.

roomQuery.description: Optional traveler-provided room or unit name, such as '5B Casita Vista'. No stay dates are required.

name: get_property_details
